name: Timna
why: 1CH 1:39: The verse names Timna sister of Lotan, and both records are the sister of Lotan (A only adds the Eliphaz concubine identification of GEN 36:12).
GEN 36:22: Both records are Timna the sister of Lotan; A states that it is this verse's sister of Lotan, so the woman is held twice.

name: Nathan
why: 1CH 11:38: 1CH 11:38 'Joel brother of Nathan' stands in the same slot of David's mighty men as 2SA 23:36 'Igal son of Nathan of Zobah', so both records hold the one Nathan of that list.

name: Joel
why: 1CH 15:11: David summons the six chiefs just listed in 15:5-10, so this Joel is the Gershomite chief of 15:7 that A holds, and B is the same man held again.

name: Benaiah
why: 1CH 15:18: Both records are the second-degree Levite Benaiah who played the psaltery before the ark.
1CH 15:20: Both records are the second-degree Levite Benaiah who played psalteries on Alamoth.

name: Joel
why: 1CH 15:7: Both records are Joel chief of the sons of Gershom at the bringing up of the ark.

name: Eliel
why: 1CH 15:9: Both records are Eliel chief of the sons of Hebron with eighty brethren.

name: Azarel
why: 1CH 25:18: Both records are the Azarel who drew the eleventh lot among the singers.

name: Shobal
why: 1CH 4:1: 1CH 4:1 is a descending line (Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, Shobal), so this is Shobal son of Hur, father of Reaiah, which both records hold.
1CH 4:2: Both records are Shobal father of Reaiah, and A's son of Hur is the same man as B's Shobal listed under Judah.

name: Ezer
why: 1CH 4:4: Both records are Ezer son of Hur, father of Hushah.

name: Uriel
why: 1CH 6:24: Both records are Uriel son of Tahath and father of Uzziah.

name: Asaiah
why: 1CH 6:30: Both records are Asaiah son of Haggiah in Merari's line.

name: Tahath
why: 1CH 6:37: Tahath son of Assir son of Ebiasaph holds the same place as in 6:23-24, and both records are son of Assir.

name: Amaziah
why: 1CH 6:45: Both records are Amaziah son of Hilkiah, father of Hashabiah, in Ethan's line.

name: Gera
why: 1CH 8:3: Both records are Gera son of Bela in this list.

name: Akkub
why: 1CH 9:17: Both records are the gatekeeper Akkub listed with Shallum, Talmon and Ahiman.

name: Ethan
why: 1KI 4:31: Both records are Ethan the Ezrahite of this verse; A only adds the possible Zerahite identification.

name: Jeiel
why: 2CH 29:13: Both records are Jeiel of the sons of Elizaphan in this verse (B wrongly calls him Gershonite).

name: Jehiel
why: 2CH 31:13: Both records hold the overseer under Conaniah in Hezekiah's reign; A identifies him with Heman's descendant Jehiel of the same reign.

name: Shaphan
why: 2CH 34:15: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2CH 34:16: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2CH 34:18: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2CH 34:8: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2KI 22:10: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2KI 22:14: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2KI 22:3: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah son of Meshullam, Josiah's scribe.
2KI 22:8: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.
2KI 22:9: Both records are Shaphan son of Azaliah, Josiah's scribe.

name: Elnathan
why: 2KI 24:8: Both records are Elnathan of Jerusalem, father of Nehushta.

name: Gaius
why: ACT 19:29: Both records are the Macedonian Gaius, Paul's travelling companion seized with Aristarchus.

name: Eliezer
why: EZR 10:18: Both records hold Eliezer, priest of the sons of Jeshua, who had married a foreign wife in 10:18.

name: Jarib
why: EZR 10:18: Both records hold Jarib, priest of the sons of Jeshua, who had married a foreign wife.

name: Jedaiah
why: EZR 2:36: Both records hold the priestly family head Jedaiah of the house of Jeshua in this list.
NEH 7:39: Both records are the priestly house of Jedaiah 'of the house of Jeshua' in the return list; A already cites NEH 7:39.

name: Elam
why: EZR 2:7: Both records hold Elam whose 1,254 descendants returned in this list.
NEH 7:12: Both records are the ancestor of the 1,254 'children of Elam' in the return list (EZR 2:7 = NEH 7:12).

name: Seraiah
why: EZR 7:1: Both records are Seraiah son of Azariah and father (ancestor) of Ezra.

name: Azariah
why: EZR 7:3: Both records hold the Azariah who is father of Amariah-2 and descendant of Meraioth in this shortened high-priestly line.

name: Shephatiah
why: EZR 8:8: Both records are the family head Shephatiah whose descendant Zebadiah ben Michael went up with Ezra, with the same ancestor-of link.

name: Amos
why: LUK 3:25: Both records are Amos, son of Naum and father of Mattathias, at the same place in Luke's genealogy.

name: Elam
why: NEH 10:14: Elam among the 'chiefs of the people' is the house of Elam (Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu... follow Ezra 2), and A already records him as named on the sealed document at 10:14, so B duplicates him.

name: Ater
why: NEH 10:17: 'Ater, Hizkijah' echoes 'Ater of Hezekiah' (Ezra 2:16), so the sealer is the house of Ater, which A records; B is the same house held again.

name: Zadok
why: NEH 10:21: A's notes already place Zadok on the sealed document at 10:21, and B is that same sealer with nothing added.

name: Rehum
why: NEH 10:25: A's notes already place Rehum on the sealed document at 10:25, and B is that same sealer with nothing added.

name: Baanah
why: NEH 10:27: A's notes already place Baanah on the sealed document at 10:27, and B is that same sealer with nothing added.

name: Harim
why: NEH 10:27: A, the house of Harim of Ezra 2:32, is already noted as sealing at 10:27, and B is that same lay sealer.

name: Malluch
why: NEH 10:27: A's notes already place Malluch on the sealed document at 10:27, and B is that same lay sealer with nothing added.

name: Harim
why: NEH 10:5: A, the priestly house of Harim, is already noted as sealing at 10:5, and B is that same priestly sealer.

name: Hashabiah
why: NEH 11:15: Both records are Hashabiah, son of Bunni and father of Azrikam, in Shemaiah's Levitical pedigree; A adds an unsupported tie to Jeduthun.

name: Akkub
why: NEH 11:19: Both records are Akkub the gatekeeper named with Talmon after the return.
NEH 12:25: Both records are Akkub the gatekeeper named with Talmon; A already cites NEH 12:25.

name: Jeremiah
why: NEH 12:1: Both records are the priest Jeremiah who came up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua and was ancestor of Hananiah (12:12), with the same family links.
NEH 12:12: Both records are the priestly house of Jeremiah headed by Hananiah under Joiakim, with the same links.

name: Meshullam
why: NEH 12:13: Both records are Meshullam, head of the house of Ezra under Joiakim at 12:13; they differ only in which Ezra they link to.

name: Iddo
why: NEH 12:16: Both records are the priestly house of Iddo from Zerubbabel's return, which Zechariah headed under Joiakim, and A's notes cite 12:16 itself.
NEH 12:4: Both records are the priest Iddo who came up with Zerubbabel; A's notes cite NEH 12:1-4, and B's house is the same Iddo's.

name: Shemaiah
why: NEH 12:18: Both records are Shemaiah, ancestor of Jehonathan in the list of priestly houses.
NEH 12:6: Both records are the priest Shemaiah, ancestor of Jehonathan (12:18), whose house stands in the Zerubbabel list.

name: Malluch
why: NEH 12:2: Both records are the priest Malluch whose house (Melicu/Malluchi) Jonathan headed, which A records through ancestor-of jonathan-11.

name: Mattaniah
why: NEH 12:35: Both records are Mattaniah ben Micaiah, father of Shemaiah, at the same point of the Asaphite pedigree in 12:35.

name: Shemaiah
why: NEH 12:35: Both records are Shemaiah ben Mattaniah, father of Jonathan, at the same point of the pedigree in 12:35.

name: Zaccur
why: NEH 13:13: Both records are Zaccur, son of Mattaniah and father of Hanan the treasurer, with identical family links.

name: Hananiah
why: NEH 3:30: Both records are Hananiah ben Shelemiah, who repaired the wall, with the same father link.

name: Arah
why: NEH 6:18: Both records hold Arah as the father of Shecaniah, Tobiah's father-in-law; B adds the house of Arah from Ezra 2:5.

name: Meshullam
why: NEH 8:4: Both records are Meshullam standing at Ezra's left hand at the reading of the law, with nothing else to tell them apart.
